name: Celebration
overview: Scripture reveals that celebration is a God-ordained response to His goodness and providence, as seen in the call to rejoice and be glad in the day the Lord has made (Psalms 118:24). It encompasses heartfelt praise to God, expressed in worship and song (Psalms 150:1), and includes recognizing appropriate seasons for joy and gladness (Ecclesiastes 3:4). Enjoying the fruits of one’s labor is also described as a gift from God (Ecclesiastes 3:13), while the celebration of Christ’s birth with worship and gifts (Matthew 2:11) exemplifies honoring God through meaningful acts. These elements together highlight celebration as a joyful acknowledgment of God’s presence and blessings in our lives.
